skills.name: Devozione
lines: Target a single party member (or leftmost member is targeted). Give them Devotion stack.
* Devotion: Add 30% of each Nona's stat (except HP/MP) to the corresponding stat of character with devotion stack (Limit: 330, +99 stat) (99.9 from 333 is rounded down)
** Effects on game mechanics:
*** Lunatic - Sacrifice is not affected by +END\+SPR parts from stack
*** Base Damage: +STATS increase STAT_stacks parts of damage.
**** SPD damage is affected greater than PWR or INT damage
*** Both direct damage and skill multipliers non-standard stats scaling are affected (Radica AS, Cynthia, Heena...)
* Activate Sforza state on user
** If Devotion was given to Aldo: Activate Vota state on user instead
* Replaces the basic attack when not in Another Force.
* Returns to basic attack after use

skills.name: Castigo
lines: Water type piercing attack on random enemies x3 (XL)
* Water type attack of all party members +30% (3 turns) and Critical rate of all party members +100% (1 move)
* When there is an ally with Devotion stack on the front line:
** Increase number of attacks by +3
** Kaleido; change element of type attack buff according to the attribute personality of the ally with Devotion
** Grants Flexible to user based on the weapon type of the ally with Devotion (permanent)
** Grant Kaleido to user; Change user's element based on element of the ally with Devotion
*** If ally has no element, defaults to Water
*** For multiple elements, random element personality will be selected
**** For Aisha or Cyrus Albright, defaults to water unless in matching Zone
**** Unaffected by further Zone changes
** Type attack buff doubled for ally with Devotion
